title: Cohort feature-flag activation and reversal
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Conduct cohort flag on/off/reversal; detect incompatible configuration/state assumptions while preserving sessions, data and prior failures.
preconditions: One synthetic deployment already contains compatible code.
The deployed synthetic reader supports configuration v1 and state v1 only.
Four fixed synthetic sessions, two pilot and two control, start with one cart item each.
actions: Enable or turn off the flag for a selected cohort
Revert flag to off without changing deployment identity
Inject/restore a declared synthetic state-version fixture
Submit a strictly typed explicit JSON event
Reset and retain prior in-memory results
expectedAssertions: Only the selected cohort observes enhanced behavior.
Observed reversal returns all sessions to standard behavior on unchanged code.
Session tokens, cart identifiers and earlier data survive compatible flag changes.
Each successful observation has one synthetic cart effect; incompatible state has none.
Unsupported configuration/state is guarded without flag publication.
Earlier interrupted attempts stay in the denominator after reversal or fixture restoration.
No observation-free, missing-baseline or missing-reversal sequence passes.
Keyboard controls, explicit accessible errors, safe rendering and CSP work in an actual browser.
trace: Deterministic ordered explicit events, requested/applied config, guard codes and per-session observations.
testRuntime: Node.js 22 test tooling only; exact version recorded in empirical evidence.
browserTooling: Existing offline Playwright 1.56.1 with installed headless Edge via testing\browser\isolated.cjs; no installation or security weakening.
limits: Not a live Azure result, migration, authentication boundary, availability measurement or SLA.
Config/state v2 is a deliberate mismatch, not a supported conversion or deployment.
Reset archives are in memory for this page session; closing/reloading loses them.
B-S010 and source-parent native acceptance remain unfulfilled.
No cloud, identity, hosting, production Node 24, or mixed-reader qualification is inferred.
